name: coverage
//: The repo-level coverage gate: clears the shared profile directory before the instrumented test runs, then merges every coverage:profiles project's profiles and enforces the 95% line floor over the llmlint crate's sources (src/), once (coverage-driver's coverage.sh). It depends on exactly what can move that number: the projects whose tests write profiles, and the driver. It is its own project, apart from the driver, so that product edits — which must re-run this gate — never select the driver's slow self-tests.

coverage.//: Uncached: the profiles it merges come from uncached test runs, so a replay could report on a set that no longer exists.
